plan: known issues carried out of the agent-dx plan

phases.name: 31 application files have no wiki page listing them in code_refs
phases.note: Individual actions, form requests and two controllers. Their areas are documented at page level, and wiki:audit reports this without blocking, on purpose: blocking it buys one-line pages written to clear a gate. Work the list with /document when a file's behaviour is worth explaining.

phases.name: local coverage run measures a subset because TIA narrows it
phases.note: pest()->tia()->locally() in tests/Pest.php restricts the run to affected files, so --coverage --exactly=100.0 reports 99.1 % locally and passes in CI, where TIA is off. Either teach composer test:unit to pass --no-tia when coverage is requested, or drop the coverage flags from the local script.

phases.name: app:doctor reports the coverage driver as FAIL under Herd
phases.note: Xdebug is not loaded by default, so the check fails on a machine where nothing is wrong. Its fix line already names `herd coverage composer test:unit`; the check could detect Herd and report the wrapper instead of a failure.
